speaker: chief-official
text: I fear my lord the king, who has assigned your food and drink. For why should he see your faces looking thinner than those of the other young men your age? You would endanger my head before the king!
name: The chief official

speaker: daniel
text: Please test your servants for ten days. Let us be given only vegetables to eat and water to drink.
name: Daniel

speaker: daniel
text: Then compare our appearances with those of the young men who are eating the royal food, and deal with your servants according to what you see.
name: Daniel

speaker: nebuchadnezzar
text: I have had a dream, and my spirit is anxious to understand it.
name: Nebuchadnezzar

speaker: astrologers
text: O king, may you live forever! Tell your servants the dream, and we will give the interpretation.
name: The astrologers

speaker: nebuchadnezzar
text: My word is final: If you do not tell me the dream and its interpretation, you will be cut into pieces and your houses will be reduced to rubble.
name: Nebuchadnezzar

speaker: nebuchadnezzar
text: But if you tell me the dream and its interpretation, you will receive from me gifts and rewards and great honor. So tell me the dream and its interpretation.
name: Nebuchadnezzar

speaker: astrologers
text: Let the king tell the dream to his servants, and we will give the interpretation.
name: The astrologers

speaker: nebuchadnezzar
text: I know for sure that you are stalling for time, because you see that my word is final.
name: Nebuchadnezzar

speaker: nebuchadnezzar
text: If you do not tell me the dream, there is only one decree for you. You have conspired to speak before me false and fraudulent words, hoping the situation will change. Therefore tell me the dream, and I will know that you can give me its interpretation.
name: Nebuchadnezzar

speaker: astrologers
text: No one on earth can do what the king requests! No king, however great and powerful, has ever asked anything like this of any magician, enchanter, or astrologer.
name: The astrologers

speaker: astrologers
text: What the king requests is so difficult that no one can tell it to him except the gods, whose dwelling is not with mortals.
name: The astrologers

speaker: daniel
text: Why is the decree from the king so harsh?
name: Daniel

speaker: daniel
text: Blessed be the name of God forever and ever, for wisdom and power belong to Him.
name: Daniel

speaker: daniel
text: He changes the times and seasons; He removes kings and establishes them. He gives wisdom to the wise and knowledge to the discerning.
name: Daniel

speaker: daniel
text: He reveals the deep and hidden things; He knows what lies in darkness, and light dwells with Him.
name: Daniel

speaker: daniel
text: To You, O God of my fathers, I give thanks and praise, because You have given me wisdom and power. And now You have made known to me what we have requested, for You have made known to us the dream of the king.
name: Daniel

speaker: daniel
text: Do not execute the wise men of Babylon! Bring me before the king, and I will give him the interpretation.
name: Daniel

speaker: arioch
text: I have found a man among the exiles from Judah who will tell the king the interpretation.
name: Arioch

speaker: nebuchadnezzar
text: Are you able to tell me what I saw in the dream, as well as its interpretation?
name: Nebuchadnezzar

speaker: daniel
text: No wise man, enchanter, medium, or magician can explain to the king the mystery of which he inquires.
name: Daniel

speaker: daniel
text: But there is a God in heaven who reveals mysteries, and He has made known to King Nebuchadnezzar what will happen in the latter days. Your dream and the visions that came into your mind as you lay on your bed were these:
name: Daniel

speaker: daniel
text: As you lay on your bed, O king, your thoughts turned to the future, and the Revealer of Mysteries made known to you what will happen.
name: Daniel

speaker: daniel
text: And to me this mystery has been revealed, not because I have more wisdom than any man alive, but in order that the interpretation might be made known to the king, and that you may understand the thoughts of your mind.
name: Daniel

speaker: daniel
text: As you, O king, were watching, a great statue appeared. A great and dazzling statue stood before you, and its form was awesome.
name: Daniel

speaker: daniel
text: The head of the statue was pure gold, its chest and arms were silver, its belly and thighs were bronze,
name: Daniel

speaker: daniel
text: its legs were iron, and its feet were part iron and part clay.
name: Daniel

speaker: daniel
text: As you watched, a stone was cut out, but not by human hands. It struck the statue on its feet of iron and clay, and crushed them.
name: Daniel

speaker: daniel
text: Then the iron, clay, bronze, silver, and gold were shattered and became like chaff on the threshing floor in summer. The wind carried them away, and not a trace of them could be found. But the stone that had struck the statue became a great mountain and filled the whole earth.
name: Daniel

speaker: daniel
text: This was the dream; now we will tell the king its interpretation.
name: Daniel

speaker: daniel
text: You, O king, are the king of kings, to whom the God of heaven has given sovereignty, power, strength, and glory.
name: Daniel

speaker: daniel
text: Wherever the sons of men or beasts of the field or birds of the air dwell, He has given them into your hand and has made you ruler over them all. You are that head of gold.
name: Daniel

speaker: daniel
text: But after you, there will arise another kingdom, inferior to yours. Next, a third kingdom, one of bronze, will rule the whole earth.
name: Daniel

speaker: daniel
text: Finally, there will be a fourth kingdom as strong as iron; for iron shatters and crushes all things, and like iron that crushes all things, it will shatter and crush all the others.
name: Daniel

speaker: daniel
text: And just as you saw that the feet and toes were made partly of fired clay and partly of iron, so this will be a divided kingdom, yet some of the strength of iron will be in it—just as you saw the iron mixed with clay.
name: Daniel

speaker: daniel
text: And as the toes of the feet were partly iron and partly clay, so this kingdom will be partly strong and partly brittle.
name: Daniel

speaker: daniel
text: As you saw the iron mixed with clay, so the peoples will mix with one another, but will not hold together any more than iron mixes with clay.
name: Daniel

speaker: daniel
text: In the days of those kings, the God of heaven will set up a kingdom that will never be destroyed, nor will it be left to another people. It will shatter all these kingdoms and bring them to an end, but will itself stand forever.
name: Daniel

speaker: daniel
text: And just as you saw a stone being cut out of the mountain without human hands, and it shattered the iron, bronze, clay, silver, and gold, so the great God has told the king what will happen in the future. The dream is true, and its interpretation is trustworthy.
name: Daniel

speaker: nebuchadnezzar
text: Your God is truly the God of gods and Lord of kings, the Revealer of Mysteries, since you were able to reveal this mystery.
name: Nebuchadnezzar

speaker: herald
text: O people of every nation and language, this is what you are commanded:
name: The herald

speaker: herald
text: As soon as you hear the sound of the horn, flute, zither, lyre, harp, pipes, and all kinds of music, you must fall down and worship the golden statue that King Nebuchadnezzar has set up.
name: The herald

speaker: herald
text: And whoever does not fall down and worship will immediately be thrown into the blazing fiery furnace.
name: The herald

speaker: accusers
text: O king, may you live forever!
name: The Chaldean accusers

speaker: accusers
text: You, O king, have issued a decree that everyone who hears the sound of the horn, flute, zither, lyre, harp, pipes, and all kinds of music must fall down and worship the golden statue,
name: The Chaldean accusers

speaker: accusers
text: and that whoever does not fall down and worship will be thrown into the blazing fiery furnace.
name: The Chaldean accusers

speaker: accusers
text: But there are some Jews you have appointed to manage the province of Babylon—Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego—who have ignored you, O king, and have refused to serve your gods or worship the golden statue you have set up.
name: The Chaldean accusers

speaker: nebuchadnezzar
text: Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, is it true that you do not serve my gods or worship the golden statue I have set up?
name: Nebuchadnezzar

speaker: nebuchadnezzar
text: Now, if you are ready, as soon as you hear the sound of the horn, flute, zither, lyre, harp, pipes, and all kinds of music, you must fall down and worship the statue I have made. But if you refuse to worship, you will be thrown at once into the blazing fiery furnace. Then what god will be able to deliver you from my hands?
name: Nebuchadnezzar

speaker: three-friends
text: O Nebuchadnezzar, we have no need to answer you in this matter.
name: Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego

speaker: three-friends
text: If the God whom we serve exists, then He is able to deliver us from the blazing fiery furnace and from your hand, O king.
name: Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego

speaker: three-friends
text: But even if He does not, let it be known to you, O king, that we will not serve your gods or worship the golden statue you have set up.
name: Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego

speaker: nebuchadnezzar
text: Did we not throw three men, firmly bound, into the fire?
name: Nebuchadnezzar

speaker: advisers
text: Certainly, O king,
name: The king's advisers

speaker: nebuchadnezzar
text: Look!
name: Nebuchadnezzar

speaker: nebuchadnezzar
text: I see four men, unbound and unharmed, walking around in the fire—and the fourth looks like a son of the gods!
name: Nebuchadnezzar

speaker: nebuchadnezzar
text: Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, servants of the Most High God, come out!
name: Nebuchadnezzar

speaker: nebuchadnezzar
text: Blessed be the God of Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, who has sent His angel and delivered His servants who trusted in Him. They violated the king’s command and risked their lives rather than serve or worship any god except their own God.
name: Nebuchadnezzar

speaker: nebuchadnezzar
text: Therefore I decree that the people of any nation or language who say anything offensive against the God of Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego will be cut into pieces and their houses reduced to rubble. For there is no other god who can deliver in this way.
name: Nebuchadnezzar

speaker: nebuchadnezzar
text: O Belteshazzar, chief of the magicians, I know that the spirit of the holy gods is in you and that no mystery baffles you. So explain to me the visions I saw in my dream, and their interpretation.
name: Nebuchadnezzar

speaker: nebuchadnezzar
text: In these visions of my mind as I was lying in bed, I saw this come to pass: There was a tree in the midst of the land, and its height was great.
name: Nebuchadnezzar

speaker: nebuchadnezzar
text: The tree grew large and strong; its top reached the sky, and it was visible to the ends of the earth.
name: Nebuchadnezzar

speaker: nebuchadnezzar
text: Its leaves were beautiful, its fruit was abundant, and upon it was food for all. Under it the beasts of the field found shelter, in its branches the birds of the air nested, and from it every creature was fed.
name: Nebuchadnezzar

speaker: nebuchadnezzar
text: As I lay on my bed, I also saw in the visions of my mind a watcher, a holy one, coming down from heaven.
name: Nebuchadnezzar

speaker: nebuchadnezzar
text: He called out in a loud voice: ‘Cut down the tree and chop off its branches; strip off its leaves and scatter its fruit. Let the beasts flee from under it, and the birds from its branches.
name: Nebuchadnezzar

speaker: nebuchadnezzar
text: But leave the stump with its roots in the ground, and a band of iron and bronze around it, in the tender grass of the field. Let him be drenched with the dew of heaven and graze with the beasts on the grass of the earth.
name: Nebuchadnezzar

speaker: nebuchadnezzar
text: Let his mind be changed from that of a man, and let him be given the mind of a beast till seven times pass him by.
name: Nebuchadnezzar

speaker: nebuchadnezzar
text: This decision is the decree of the watchers, the verdict declared by the holy ones, so that the living will know that the Most High rules over the kingdom of mankind and gives it to whom He wishes, setting over it the lowliest of men.’
name: Nebuchadnezzar

speaker: nebuchadnezzar
text: This is the dream that I, King Nebuchadnezzar, saw. Now, Belteshazzar, tell me the interpretation, because none of the wise men of my kingdom can interpret it for me. But you are able, because the spirit of the holy gods is in you.
name: Nebuchadnezzar

speaker: nebuchadnezzar
text: Belteshazzar, do not let the dream or its interpretation alarm you.
name: Nebuchadnezzar

speaker: daniel
text: My lord,
name: Daniel

speaker: daniel
text: may the dream apply to those who hate you, and its interpretation to your enemies!
name: Daniel

speaker: daniel
text: The tree you saw that grew large and strong, whose top reached the sky and was visible to all the earth,
name: Daniel

speaker: daniel
text: whose foliage was beautiful and whose fruit was abundant, providing food for all, under which the beasts of the field lived, and in whose branches the birds of the air nested—
name: Daniel

speaker: daniel
text: you, O king, are that tree! For you have become great and strong; your greatness has grown to reach the sky, and your dominion extends to the ends of the earth.
name: Daniel

speaker: daniel
text: And you, O king, saw a watcher, a holy one, coming down from heaven and saying: ‘Cut down the tree and destroy it, but leave the stump with its roots in the ground, and a band of iron and bronze around it, in the tender grass of the field. Let him be drenched with the dew of heaven, and graze with the beasts of the field till seven times pass him by.’
name: Daniel

speaker: daniel
text: This is the interpretation, O king, and this is the decree that the Most High has issued against my lord the king:
name: Daniel

speaker: daniel
text: You will be driven away from mankind, and your dwelling will be with the beasts of the field. You will feed on grass like an ox and be drenched with the dew of heaven, and seven times shall pass you by, until you acknowledge that the Most High rules over the kingdom of mankind and gives it to whom He wishes.
name: Daniel

speaker: daniel
text: As for the command to leave the stump of the tree with its roots, your kingdom will be restored to you as soon as you acknowledge that Heaven rules.
name: Daniel

speaker: daniel
text: Therefore, may my advice be pleasing to you, O king. Break away from your sins by doing what is right, and from your iniquities by showing mercy to the oppressed. Perhaps there will be an extension of your prosperity.
name: Daniel

speaker: nebuchadnezzar
text: Is this not Babylon the Great, which I myself have built by the might of my power as a royal residence and for the glory of my majesty?
name: Nebuchadnezzar

speaker: voice-from-heaven
text: It is decreed to you, King Nebuchadnezzar, that the kingdom has departed from you.
name: A voice from heaven

speaker: voice-from-heaven
text: You will be driven away from mankind to live with the beasts of the field, and you will feed on grass like an ox. And seven times will pass you by, until you acknowledge that the Most High rules over the kingdom of mankind and gives it to whom He wishes.
name: A voice from heaven

speaker: nebuchadnezzar
text: For His dominion is an everlasting dominion, and His kingdom endures from generation to generation.
name: Nebuchadnezzar

speaker: nebuchadnezzar
text: All the peoples of the earth are counted as nothing, and He does as He pleases with the army of heaven and the peoples of the earth. There is no one who can restrain His hand or say to Him, ‘What have You done?’
name: Nebuchadnezzar

speaker: belshazzar
text: Whoever reads this inscription and tells me its interpretation will be clothed in purple and have a gold chain placed around his neck, and he will be made the third highest ruler in the kingdom.
name: Belshazzar

speaker: queen
text: O king, may you live forever!
name: The queen

speaker: queen
text: Do not let your thoughts terrify you, or your face grow pale.
name: The queen

speaker: queen
text: There is a man in your kingdom who has the spirit of the holy gods in him. In the days of your father he was found to have insight, intelligence, and wisdom like that of the gods. Your father, King Nebuchadnezzar, appointed him chief of the magicians, enchanters, astrologers, and diviners. Your own father, the king,
name: The queen

speaker: queen
text: did this because Daniel, the one he named Belteshazzar, was found to have an extraordinary spirit, as well as knowledge, understanding, and the ability to interpret dreams, explain riddles, and solve difficult problems. Summon Daniel, therefore, and he will give you the interpretation.
name: The queen

speaker: belshazzar
text: Are you Daniel, one of the exiles my father the king brought from Judah?
name: Belshazzar

speaker: belshazzar
text: I have heard that the spirit of the gods is in you, and that you have insight, intelligence, and extraordinary wisdom.
name: Belshazzar

speaker: belshazzar
text: Now the wise men and enchanters were brought before me to read this inscription and interpret it for me, but they could not give its interpretation.
name: Belshazzar

speaker: belshazzar
text: But I have heard about you, that you are able to give interpretations and solve difficult problems. Therefore, if you can read this inscription and give me its interpretation, you will be clothed in purple and have a gold chain placed around your neck, and you will be made the third highest ruler in the kingdom.
name: Belshazzar

speaker: daniel
text: You may keep your gifts for yourself and give your rewards to someone else. Nevertheless, I will read the inscription for the king and interpret it for him.
name: Daniel

speaker: daniel
text: As for you, O king, the Most High God gave your father Nebuchadnezzar sovereignty and greatness, glory and honor.
name: Daniel

speaker: daniel
text: Because of the greatness that He bestowed on him, the people of every nation and language trembled in fear before him. He killed whom he wished and kept alive whom he wished; he exalted whom he wished and humbled whom he wished.
name: Daniel

speaker: daniel
text: But when his heart became arrogant and his spirit was hardened with pride, he was deposed from his royal throne, and his glory was taken from him.
name: Daniel

speaker: daniel
text: He was driven away from mankind, and his mind was like that of a beast. He lived with the wild donkeys and ate grass like an ox, and his body was drenched with the dew of heaven until he acknowledged that the Most High God rules over the kingdom of mankind, setting over it whom He wishes.
name: Daniel

speaker: daniel
text: But you his son, O Belshazzar, have not humbled your heart, even though you knew all this.
name: Daniel

speaker: daniel
text: Instead, you have exalted yourself against the Lord of heaven. The vessels from His house were brought to you, and as you drank wine from them with your nobles, wives, and concubines, you praised your gods of silver and gold, bronze and iron, wood and stone, which cannot see or hear or understand. But you have failed to glorify the God who holds in His hand your very breath and all your ways.
name: Daniel

speaker: daniel
text: Therefore He sent the hand that wrote the inscription.
name: Daniel

speaker: daniel
text: Now this is the inscription that was written: MENE, MENE, TEKEL, PARSIN.
name: Daniel

speaker: daniel
text: And this is the interpretation of the message: MENE means that God has numbered the days of your reign and brought it to an end.
name: Daniel

speaker: daniel
text: TEKEL means that you have been weighed on the scales and found deficient.
name: Daniel

speaker: daniel
text: PERES means that your kingdom has been divided and given over to the Medes and Persians.
name: Daniel

speaker: officials
text: We will never find any charge against this Daniel, unless we find something against him concerning the law of his God.
name: The administrators and satraps

speaker: officials
text: O King Darius, may you live forever!
name: The administrators and satraps

speaker: officials
text: All the royal administrators, prefects, satraps, advisers, and governors have agreed that the king should establish an ordinance and enforce a decree that for thirty days anyone who petitions any god or man except you, O king, will be thrown into the den of lions.
name: The administrators and satraps

speaker: officials
text: Therefore, O king, establish the decree and sign the document so that it cannot be changed—in accordance with the law of the Medes and Persians, which cannot be repealed.
name: The administrators and satraps

speaker: officials
text: Did you not sign a decree that for thirty days any man who petitions any god or man except you, O king, will be thrown into the den of lions?
name: The administrators and satraps

speaker: darius
text: According to the law of the Medes and Persians the order stands, and it cannot be repealed.
name: Darius

speaker: officials
text: Daniel, one of the exiles from Judah, shows no regard for you, O king, or for the decree that you have signed. He still makes his petition three times a day.
name: The administrators and satraps

speaker: officials
text: Remember, O king, that by the law of the Medes and Persians no decree or ordinance established by the king can be changed.
name: The administrators and satraps

speaker: darius
text: May your God, whom you serve continually, deliver you!
name: Darius

speaker: darius
text: O Daniel, servant of the living God, has your God, whom you serve continually, been able to deliver you from the lions?
name: Darius

speaker: daniel
text: O king, may you live forever!
name: Daniel

speaker: daniel
text: My God sent His angel and shut the mouths of the lions. They have not hurt me, for I was found innocent in His sight, and I have done no wrong against you, O king.
name: Daniel

speaker: darius
text: May your prosperity abound.
name: Darius

speaker: darius
text: I hereby decree that in every part of my kingdom, men are to tremble in fear before the God of Daniel: For He is the living God, and He endures forever; His kingdom will never be destroyed, and His dominion will never end.
name: Darius

speaker: darius
text: He delivers and rescues; He performs signs and wonders in the heavens and on the earth, for He has rescued Daniel from the power of the lions.
name: Darius

speaker: daniel
text: In my vision in the night I looked, and suddenly the four winds of heaven were churning up the great sea.
name: Daniel

speaker: daniel
text: Then four great beasts came up out of the sea, each one different from the others:
name: Daniel

speaker: daniel
text: The first beast was like a lion, and it had the wings of an eagle. I watched until its wings were torn off and it was lifted up from the ground and made to stand on two feet like a man, and given the mind of a man.
name: Daniel

speaker: daniel
text: Suddenly another beast appeared, which looked like a bear. It was raised up on one of its sides, and it had three ribs in its mouth between its teeth. So it was told, ‘Get up and gorge yourself on flesh!’
name: Daniel

speaker: daniel
text: Next, as I watched, another beast appeared. It was like a leopard, and on its back it had four wings like those of a bird. The beast also had four heads, and it was given authority to rule.
name: Daniel

speaker: daniel
text: After this, as I watched in my vision in the night, suddenly a fourth beast appeared, and it was terrifying—dreadful and extremely strong—with large iron teeth. It devoured and crushed; then it trampled underfoot whatever was left. It was different from all the beasts before it, and it had ten horns.
name: Daniel

speaker: daniel
text: While I was contemplating the horns, suddenly another horn, a little one, came up among them, and three of the first horns were uprooted before it. This horn had eyes like those of a man and a mouth that spoke words of arrogance.
name: Daniel

speaker: daniel
text: As I continued to watch, thrones were set in place, and the Ancient of Days took His seat. His clothing was white as snow, and the hair of His head was like pure wool. His throne was flaming with fire, and its wheels were all ablaze.
name: Daniel

speaker: daniel
text: A river of fire was flowing, coming out from His presence. Thousands upon thousands attended Him, and myriads upon myriads stood before Him. The court was convened, and the books were opened.
name: Daniel

speaker: daniel
text: Then I kept watching because of the arrogant words the horn was speaking. As I continued to watch, the beast was slain, and its body was destroyed and thrown into the blazing fire.
name: Daniel

speaker: daniel
text: As for the rest of the beasts, their dominion was removed, but they were granted an extension of life for a season and a time.
name: Daniel

speaker: daniel
text: In my vision in the night I continued to watch, and I saw One like the Son of Man coming with the clouds of heaven. He approached the Ancient of Days and was led into His presence.
name: Daniel

speaker: daniel
text: And He was given dominion, glory, and kingship, that the people of every nation and language should serve Him. His dominion is an everlasting dominion that will not pass away, and His kingdom is one that will never be destroyed.
name: Daniel

speaker: daniel
text: I, Daniel, was grieved in my spirit, and the visions in my mind alarmed me.
name: Daniel

speaker: daniel
text: I approached one of those who were standing there, and I asked him the true meaning of all this. So he told me the interpretation of these things:
name: Daniel

speaker: daniel
text: ‘These four great beasts are four kings who will arise from the earth.
name: Daniel

speaker: daniel
text: But the saints of the Most High will receive the kingdom and possess it forever—yes, forever and ever.’
name: Daniel

speaker: daniel
text: Then I wanted to know the true meaning of the fourth beast, which was different from all the others—extremely terrifying—devouring and crushing with iron teeth and bronze claws, then trampling underfoot whatever was left.
name: Daniel

speaker: daniel
text: I also wanted to know about the ten horns on its head and the other horn that came up, before which three of them fell—the horn whose appearance was more imposing than the others, with eyes and with a mouth that spoke words of arrogance.
name: Daniel

speaker: daniel
text: As I watched, this horn was waging war against the saints and prevailing against them,
name: Daniel

speaker: daniel
text: until the Ancient of Days arrived and pronounced judgment in favor of the saints of the Most High, and the time came for them to possess the kingdom.
name: Daniel

speaker: daniel
text: This is what he said: ‘The fourth beast is a fourth kingdom that will appear on the earth, different from all the other kingdoms, and it will devour the whole earth, trample it down, and crush it.
name: Daniel

speaker: daniel
text: And the ten horns are ten kings who will rise from this kingdom. After them another king, different from the earlier ones, will rise and subdue three kings.
name: Daniel

speaker: daniel
text: He will speak out against the Most High and oppress the saints of the Most High, intending to change the appointed times and laws; and the saints will be given into his hand for a time, and times, and half a time.
name: Daniel

speaker: daniel
text: But the court will convene, and his dominion will be taken away and completely destroyed forever.
name: Daniel

speaker: daniel
text: Then the sovereignty, dominion, and greatness of the kingdoms under all of heaven will be given to the people, the saints of the Most High. His kingdom will be an everlasting kingdom, and all rulers will serve and obey Him.’
name: Daniel

speaker: daniel
text: Thus ends the matter. As for me, Daniel, my thoughts troubled me greatly, and my face turned pale. But I kept the matter to myself.
name: Daniel

speaker: holy-one
text: How long until the fulfillment of the vision of the daily sacrifice, the rebellion that causes desolation, and the surrender of the sanctuary and of the host to be trampled?
name: A holy one

speaker: holy-one
text: It will take 2,300 evenings and mornings; then the sanctuary will be properly restored.
name: A holy one

speaker: voice
text: Gabriel, explain the vision to this man.
name: A voice from the Ulai

speaker: gabriel
text: Son of man,
name: Gabriel

speaker: gabriel
text: understand that the vision concerns the time of the end.
name: Gabriel

speaker: gabriel
text: Behold, I will make known to you what will happen in the latter time of wrath, because it concerns the appointed time of the end.
name: Gabriel

speaker: gabriel
text: The two-horned ram that you saw represents the kings of Media and Persia.
name: Gabriel

speaker: gabriel
text: The shaggy goat represents the king of Greece, and the large horn between his eyes is the first king.
name: Gabriel

speaker: gabriel
text: The four horns that replaced the broken one represent four kingdoms that will rise from that nation, but will not have the same power.
name: Gabriel

speaker: gabriel
text: In the latter part of their reign, when the rebellion has reached its full measure, an insolent king, skilled in intrigue, will come to the throne.
name: Gabriel

speaker: gabriel
text: His power will be great, but it will not be his own. He will cause terrible destruction and succeed in whatever he does. He will destroy the mighty men along with the holy people.
name: Gabriel

speaker: gabriel
text: Through his craft and by his hand, he will cause deceit to prosper, and in his own mind he will make himself great. In a time of peace he will destroy many, and he will even stand against the Prince of princes. Yet he will be broken off, but not by human hands.
name: Gabriel

speaker: gabriel
text: The vision of the evenings and the mornings that has been spoken is true. Now you must seal up the vision, for it concerns the distant future.
name: Gabriel

speaker: daniel
text: O, Lord, the great and awesome God, who keeps His covenant of loving devotion to those who love Him and keep His commandments,
name: Daniel

speaker: daniel
text: we have sinned and done wrong. We have acted wickedly and rebelled. We have turned away from Your commandments and ordinances.
name: Daniel

speaker: daniel
text: We have not listened to Your servants the prophets, who spoke in Your name to our kings, leaders, and fathers, and to all the people of the land.
name: Daniel

speaker: daniel
text: To You, O Lord, belongs righteousness, but this day we are covered with shame—the men of Judah, the people of Jerusalem, and all Israel near and far, in all the countries to which You have driven us because of our unfaithfulness to You.
name: Daniel

speaker: daniel
text: O LORD, we are covered with shame—our kings, our leaders, and our fathers—because we have sinned against You.
name: Daniel

speaker: daniel
text: To the Lord our God belong compassion and forgiveness, even though we have rebelled against Him
name: Daniel

speaker: daniel
text: and have not obeyed the voice of the LORD our God to walk in His laws, which He set before us through His servants the prophets.
name: Daniel

speaker: daniel
text: All Israel has transgressed Your law and turned away, refusing to obey Your voice; so the oath and the curse written in the Law of Moses the servant of God has been poured out on us, because we have sinned against You.
name: Daniel

speaker: daniel
text: You have carried out the words spoken against us and against our rulers by bringing upon us a great disaster. For under all of heaven, nothing has ever been done like what has been done to Jerusalem.
name: Daniel

speaker: daniel
text: Just as it is written in the Law of Moses, all this disaster has come upon us, yet we have not sought the favor of the LORD our God by turning from our iniquities and giving attention to Your truth.
name: Daniel

speaker: daniel
text: Therefore the LORD has kept the calamity in store and brought it upon us. For the LORD our God is righteous in all He does; yet we have not obeyed His voice.
name: Daniel

speaker: daniel
text: Now, O Lord our God, who brought Your people out of the land of Egypt with a mighty hand, and who made for Yourself a name renowned to this day, we have sinned; we have acted wickedly.
name: Daniel

speaker: daniel
text: O Lord, in keeping with all Your righteous acts, I pray that Your anger and wrath may turn away from Your city Jerusalem, Your holy mountain; for because of our sins and the iniquities of our fathers, Jerusalem and Your people are a reproach to all around us.
name: Daniel

speaker: daniel
text: So now, our God, hear the prayers and petitions of Your servant. For Your sake, O Lord, cause Your face to shine upon Your desolate sanctuary.
name: Daniel

speaker: daniel
text: Incline Your ear, O my God, and hear; open Your eyes and see the desolation of the city that bears Your name. For we are not presenting our petitions before You because of our righteous acts, but because of Your great compassion.
name: Daniel

speaker: daniel
text: O Lord, listen! O Lord, forgive! O Lord, hear and act! For Your sake, O my God, do not delay, because Your city and Your people bear Your name.
name: Daniel

speaker: gabriel
text: O Daniel, I have come now to give you insight and understanding.
name: Gabriel

speaker: gabriel
text: At the beginning of your petitions, an answer went out, and I have come to tell you, for you are highly precious. So consider the message and understand the vision:
name: Gabriel

speaker: gabriel
text: Seventy weeks are decreed for your people and your holy city to stop their transgression, to put an end to sin, to make atonement for iniquity, to bring in everlasting righteousness, to seal up vision and prophecy, and to anoint the Most Holy Place.
name: Gabriel

speaker: gabriel
text: Know and understand this: From the issuance of the decree to restore and rebuild Jerusalem, until the Messiah, the Prince, there will be seven weeks and sixty-two weeks. It will be rebuilt with streets and a trench, but in times of distress.
name: Gabriel

speaker: gabriel
text: Then after the sixty-two weeks the Messiah will be cut off and will have nothing. Then the people of the prince who is to come will destroy the city and the sanctuary. The end will come like a flood, and until the end there will be war; desolations have been decreed.
name: Gabriel

speaker: gabriel
text: And he will confirm a covenant with many for one week, but in the middle of the week he will put an end to sacrifice and offering. And on the wing of the temple will come the abomination that causes desolation, until the decreed destruction is poured out upon him.
name: Gabriel

speaker: heavenly-man
text: Daniel, you are a man who is highly precious. Consider carefully the words that I am about to say to you. Stand up, for I have now been sent to you.
name: The man in linen

speaker: heavenly-man
text: Do not be afraid, Daniel,
name: The man in linen

speaker: heavenly-man
text: for from the first day that you purposed to understand and to humble yourself before your God, your words were heard, and I have come in response to them.
name: The man in linen

speaker: heavenly-man
text: However, the prince of the kingdom of Persia opposed me for twenty-one days. Then Michael, one of the chief princes, came to help me, for I had been left there with the kings of Persia.
name: The man in linen

speaker: heavenly-man
text: Now I have come to explain to you what will happen to your people in the latter days, for the vision concerns those days.
name: The man in linen

speaker: daniel
text: My lord, because of the vision, I am overcome with anguish, and I have no strength.
name: Daniel

speaker: daniel
text: How can I, your servant, speak with you, my lord? Now I have no strength, nor is any breath left in me.
name: Daniel

speaker: heavenly-man
text: Do not be afraid, you who are highly precious,
name: The man in linen

speaker: heavenly-man
text: Peace be with you! Be strong now; be very strong!
name: The man in linen

speaker: daniel
text: Speak, my lord, for you have strengthened me.
name: Daniel

speaker: heavenly-man
text: Do you know why I have come to you?
name: The man in linen

speaker: heavenly-man
text: I must return at once to fight against the prince of Persia, and when I have gone forth, behold, the prince of Greece will come.
name: The man in linen

speaker: heavenly-man
text: But first I will tell you what is inscribed in the Book of Truth. Yet no one has the courage to support me against these, except Michael your prince.
name: The man in linen

speaker: heavenly-man
text: And I, in the first year of Darius the Mede, stood up to strengthen and protect him.
name: The man in linen

speaker: heavenly-man
text: Now then, I will tell you the truth: Three more kings will arise in Persia, and then a fourth, who will be far richer than all the others. By the power of his wealth, he will stir up everyone against the kingdom of Greece.
name: The man in linen

speaker: heavenly-man
text: Then a mighty king will arise, who will rule with great authority and do as he pleases.
name: The man in linen

speaker: heavenly-man
text: But as soon as he is established, his kingdom will be broken up and parceled out toward the four winds of heaven. It will not go to his descendants, nor will it have the authority with which he ruled, because his kingdom will be uprooted and given to others.
name: The man in linen

speaker: heavenly-man
text: The king of the South will grow strong, but one of his commanders will grow even stronger and will rule his own kingdom with great authority.
name: The man in linen

speaker: heavenly-man
text: After some years they will form an alliance, and the daughter of the king of the South will go to the king of the North to seal the agreement. But his daughter will not retain her position of power, nor will his strength endure. At that time she will be given up, along with her royal escort and her father and the one who supported her.
name: The man in linen

speaker: heavenly-man
text: But one from her family line will rise up in his place, come against the army of the king of the North, and enter his fortress, fighting and prevailing.
name: The man in linen

speaker: heavenly-man
text: He will take even their gods captive to Egypt, with their metal images and their precious vessels of silver and gold. For some years he will stay away from the king of the North,
name: The man in linen

speaker: heavenly-man
text: who will invade the realm of the king of the South and then return to his own land.
name: The man in linen

speaker: heavenly-man
text: But his sons will stir up strife and assemble a great army, which will advance forcefully, sweeping through like a flood, and will again carry the battle as far as his fortress.
name: The man in linen

speaker: heavenly-man
text: In a rage, the king of the South will march out to fight the king of the North, who will raise a large army, but it will be delivered into the hand of his enemy.
name: The man in linen

speaker: heavenly-man
text: When the army is carried off, the king of the South will be proud in heart and will cast down tens of thousands, but he will not triumph.
name: The man in linen

speaker: heavenly-man
text: For the king of the North will raise another army, larger than the first, and after some years he will advance with a great army and many supplies.
name: The man in linen

speaker: heavenly-man
text: In those times many will rise up against the king of the South. Violent ones among your own people will exalt themselves in fulfillment of the vision, but they will fail.
name: The man in linen

speaker: heavenly-man
text: Then the king of the North will come, build up a siege ramp, and capture a fortified city. The forces of the South will not stand; even their best troops will not be able to resist.
name: The man in linen

speaker: heavenly-man
text: The invader will do as he pleases, and no one will stand against him. He will establish himself in the Beautiful Land, with destruction in his hand.
name: The man in linen

speaker: heavenly-man
text: He will resolve to come with the strength of his whole kingdom, and will reach an agreement with the king of the South. He will give him a daughter in marriage in order to overthrow the kingdom, but his plan will not succeed or help him.
name: The man in linen

speaker: heavenly-man
text: Then he will turn his face to the coastlands and capture many of them. But a commander will put an end to his reproach and will turn it back upon him.
name: The man in linen

speaker: heavenly-man
text: After this, he will turn back toward the fortresses of his own land, but he will stumble and fall and be no more.
name: The man in linen

speaker: heavenly-man
text: In his place one will arise who will send out a tax collector for the glory of the kingdom; but within a few days he will be destroyed, though not in anger or in battle.
name: The man in linen

speaker: heavenly-man
text: In his place a despicable person will arise; royal honors will not be given to him, but he will come in a time of peace and seize the kingdom by intrigue.
name: The man in linen

speaker: heavenly-man
text: Then a flood of forces will be swept away before him and destroyed, along with a prince of the covenant.
name: The man in linen

speaker: heavenly-man
text: After an alliance is made with him, he will act deceitfully; for he will rise to power with only a few people.
name: The man in linen

speaker: heavenly-man
text: In a time of peace, he will invade the richest provinces and do what his fathers and forefathers never did. He will lavish plunder, loot, and wealth on his followers, and he will plot against the strongholds—but only for a time.
name: The man in linen

speaker: heavenly-man
text: And with a large army he will stir up his power and his courage against the king of the South, who will mobilize a very large and powerful army but will not withstand the plots devised against him.
name: The man in linen

speaker: heavenly-man
text: Those who eat from his provisions will seek to destroy him; his army will be swept away, and many will fall slain.
name: The man in linen

speaker: heavenly-man
text: And the two kings, with their hearts bent on evil, will speak lies at the same table, but to no avail, for still the end will come at the appointed time.
name: The man in linen

speaker: heavenly-man
text: The king of the North will return to his land with great wealth, but his heart will be set against the holy covenant; so he will do damage and return to his own land.
name: The man in linen

speaker: heavenly-man
text: At the appointed time he will invade the South again, but this time will not be like the first.
name: The man in linen

speaker: heavenly-man
text: Ships of Kittim will come against him, and he will lose heart. Then he will turn back and rage against the holy covenant and do damage. So he will return and show favor to those who forsake the holy covenant.
name: The man in linen

speaker: heavenly-man
text: His forces will rise up and desecrate the temple fortress. They will abolish the daily sacrifice and set up the abomination of desolation.
name: The man in linen

speaker: heavenly-man
text: With flattery he will corrupt those who violate the covenant, but the people who know their God will firmly resist him.
name: The man in linen

speaker: heavenly-man
text: Those with insight will instruct many, though for a time they will fall by sword or flame, or be captured or plundered.
name: The man in linen

speaker: heavenly-man
text: Now when they fall, they will be granted a little help, but many will join them insincerely.
name: The man in linen

speaker: heavenly-man
text: Some of the wise will fall, so that they may be refined, purified, and made spotless until the time of the end, for it will still come at the appointed time.
name: The man in linen

speaker: heavenly-man
text: Then the king will do as he pleases and will exalt and magnify himself above every god, and he will speak monstrous things against the God of gods. He will be successful until the time of wrath is completed, for what has been decreed must be accomplished.
name: The man in linen

speaker: heavenly-man
text: He will show no regard for the gods of his fathers, nor for the one desired by women, nor for any other god, because he will magnify himself above them all.
name: The man in linen

speaker: heavenly-man
text: And in their place, he will honor a god of fortresses—a god his fathers did not know—with gold, silver, precious stones, and riches.
name: The man in linen

speaker: heavenly-man
text: He will attack the strongest fortresses with the help of a foreign god and will greatly honor those who acknowledge him, making them rulers over many and distributing the land for a price.
name: The man in linen

speaker: heavenly-man
text: At the time of the end, the king of the South will engage him in battle, but the king of the North will storm out against him with chariots, horsemen, and many ships, invading many countries and sweeping through them like a flood.
name: The man in linen

speaker: heavenly-man
text: He will also invade the Beautiful Land, and many countries will fall. But these will be delivered from his hand: Edom, Moab, and the leaders of the Ammonites.
name: The man in linen

speaker: heavenly-man
text: He will extend his power over many countries, and not even the land of Egypt will escape.
name: The man in linen

speaker: heavenly-man
text: He will gain control of the treasures of gold and silver and over all the riches of Egypt, and the Libyans and Cushites will also submit to him.
name: The man in linen

speaker: heavenly-man
text: But news from the east and the north will alarm him, and he will go out with great fury to destroy many and devote them to destruction.
name: The man in linen

speaker: heavenly-man
text: He will pitch his royal tents between the sea and the beautiful holy mountain, but he will meet his end with no one to help him.
name: The man in linen

speaker: heavenly-man
text: At that time Michael, the great prince who stands watch over your people, will rise up. There will be a time of distress, the likes of which will not have occurred from the beginning of nations until that time. But at that time your people—everyone whose name is found written in the book—will be delivered.
name: The man in linen

speaker: heavenly-man
text: And many who sleep in the dust of the earth will awake, some to everlasting life, but others to shame and everlasting contempt.
name: The man in linen

speaker: heavenly-man
text: Then the wise will shine like the brightness of the heavens, and those who lead many to righteousness will shine like the stars forever and ever.
name: The man in linen

speaker: heavenly-man
text: But you, Daniel, shut up these words and seal the book until the time of the end. Many will roam to and fro, and knowledge will increase.
name: The man in linen

speaker: angel
text: How long until the fulfillment of these wonders?
name: An angel

speaker: heavenly-man
text: It will be for a time, and times, and half a time. When the power of the holy people has finally been shattered, all these things will be completed.
name: The man in linen

speaker: daniel
text: My lord, what will be the outcome of these things?
name: Daniel

speaker: heavenly-man
text: Go on your way, Daniel,
name: The man in linen

speaker: heavenly-man
text: for the words are closed up and sealed until the time of the end.
name: The man in linen

speaker: heavenly-man
text: Many will be purified, made spotless, and refined, but the wicked will continue to act wickedly. None of the wicked will understand, but the wise will understand.
name: The man in linen

speaker: heavenly-man
text: And from the time the daily sacrifice is abolished and the abomination of desolation set up, there will be 1,290 days.
name: The man in linen

speaker: heavenly-man
text: Blessed is he who waits and reaches the end of the 1,335 days.
name: The man in linen

speaker: heavenly-man
text: But as for you, go on your way until the end. You will rest, and will arise to your inheritance at the end of the days.
name: The man in linen
